facts.value: Available for first-year students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of eight semesters, beginning with their first term of enrollment at ASU.
Available for two-year community college transfer students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of 5 semesters, beginning with their first term of enrollment at ASU.
Available for four-year institution transfer students admitted in spring 2026 or earlier, up to a maximum of 120 credit hours, including all transfer credits.
